extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia editors / contributors (people attempting to create or find categories)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating or locating a Wikipedia Category page (here: 'Media hoaxes'), including account requirements, checks for existing/redirected titles, and troubleshooting missing category pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account requirement to create category
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account to create this page. Alternatively, you can request the creation of a new category.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only logged-in users can create category pages; if you cannot or prefer not to create it yourself, request the category's creation through normal Wikipedia channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing categories before creating
rubrics_metrics.description: Please browse through the existing categories to check if this category is covered under another name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search for "Media hoaxes" in existing pages within the Category namespace. Also look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title to determine whether a separate category is needed or duplicates exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for alternative capitalizations and consider redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new category, verify capitalization variants and, if appropriate, create or use a redirect to the canonical category name rather than making a duplicate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allow for database update delay / use purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a newly created category does not appear, either wait for the database to update or use the purge function to force an update/view of recent changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page missing
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a category you expect is absent, consult the deletion log to determine whether it was removed and to read the rationale or instructions related to deletion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Empty category may not reflect recent changes
rubrics_metrics.description: There are no pages or files in this category. This list may not reflect recent changes (learn more).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An empty category might genuinely have no entries or might be temporarily out of date; verify via recent changes, linked pages, or by waiting for updates before creating a new category.
